CustomField.description: Set (once, at the financial system go-live) on accounts whose Exact data may be out of date. The account is then pushed in full before its next order sync and before its next invoice (Batch_FinancialSystemForceSync, invoice due within a few days). Any successful account sync (button, batch) clears it; false = assumed in sync with Exact.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked: the account is synchronised in full with Exact before its next order or invoice. Cleared automatically after a successful Exact sync.
CustomField.label: Exact Sync before Order/Invoice
